question: Consider the function $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, defined as follows: $f(x)=\begin{cases}(x-1)\min\{x,x^2\},&x\ge0,\\x\min\left\{x,\frac1x\right\},&x<0.\end{cases}$ Then, $f$ is

options.B: not differentiable at exactly one point.
options.C: not differentiable at exactly two points.
options.D: not differentiable at exactly three points.
